name: Brother Hotel
detail: The location was very convenient for travel since it was in front of the MRT station. There were also many convenience stores and restaurants around the hotel. It was helpful that they stored my luggage before and after check-in. The staff was very friendly and approachable, which made it enjoyable. The breakfast was delicious, and the chicken curry I had was spicy and addictively tasty. I would like to use this hotel again.

name: Poshpacker Hotel
detail: It is within walking distance to Ximen, and the room was cleaner than I expected. There was water and snacks available. The shower and toilet were also kept clean. I didn't feel any noise and was able to sleep soundly. The front staff were very kind, and they took care of my luggage after checkout with great attention. I'm very happy that there is a female-only building. I would like to stay again.
area: Taipei Main Station,Taipei - View on map

name: Park Taipei Hotel
detail: I have been to Taiwan several times, but each time I stayed around Ximending. This time, since I was traveling with my child, I wanted to find a quieter neighborhood. Even though my child is preschool-aged, it was uncomfortable for all three of us to sleep in a double bed, so I looked for a place with a queen-size bed or larger. Here, we had a king-size bed, and we slept very comfortably! The location was great, right next to the MRT, and there was a bus stop nearby, making it easy to get around! Since the place was a bit older, the bathroom was a little disappointing (it had a bit of an odor), but when we mentioned that we needed more towels, they quickly provided them, and the cleaning was very thorough! There was also a bathtub, which my child loved. The staff were very friendly too! If I come again with my family, I would love to stay here!

name: Just Live Hostel
detail: This is my first solo trip, and I've come to this hostel. The attitude of the front desk staff is very good and friendly. The atmosphere of the entire place is great; you won't feel scared or uneasy. In the evening, other travelers are sitting in the lounge, wearing headphones and watching movies, so it won't disturb each other. Waiting for laundry in the lounge isn't scary either. As for the bathroom, the floor is very clean, and every time I take a shower, the floor is dry. There is also a place provided for makeup. Next door is a McDonald's, and it's only a five-minute walk from Taipei Station. Highly recommended!
area: Taipei Main Station,Taipei - View on map

name: Taipei Fullerton Hotel - South
detail: I stayed for three nights this time. It is about a 3-minute walk from Da'an MRT Station, making it very convenient if you use the MRT. Also, it is very close, just four stations, from Songshan Airport without any transfers. The room is adequately spacious, and the bathtub and shower are separated, making it easy to use. There’s a kettle, and two bottles of mineral water are provided daily, along with coffee and tea. The TV has NHK available. It would have been perfect if there was a shower toilet. Breakfast had just the minimum essentials. There was a coffee machine in the lobby that guests could use freely, and it would have been nice if there was one in the breakfast restaurant as well. There is a small gym and sauna on the top floor, but I couldn't use them as the hours of operation didn’t align with my schedule. It would be great if they opened during the late-night hours. The staff are kind, but it seems they don't volunteer information unless asked. During check-in, I was only given an explanation about breakfast, and it would have been better if they provided a bit more information. However, they do answer any questions you ask. There are some places to eat nearby. I think it is a convenient hotel if you are using Songshan Airport or the MRT.

name: Cityinn Hotel Plus Fuxing N.Rd. Branch
detail: Just a 1-minute walk from Nakayama Kunikawa Station, it's also conveniently accessible. The indoor area and lobby are clean. All the towels in the room have a smiley face logo, which is heartwarming. Coffee is free, and there are snacks, cola, and water available in the room. After 10 pm, there is also a cup noodle service available as a late-night snack. The spacious area on the 2nd floor of the hotel features a café-style, stylish space where you can buy food and enjoy it, allowing for relaxation outside of your room! The prices are reasonable, so I truly recommend it.

name: Mayer Inn
detail: It is located in the building next to Shin Kong Mitsukoshi right in front of Taipei Station. When I stayed, the front staff did not speak Japanese, so they assisted me in English, but I was able to check in without any issues by presenting my passport. The room had a cute cat-foot bathtub, and the bathroom was spacious and clean, allowing me to relax and relieve my travel fatigue. The room was quite large, so having a lot of luggage was not a problem. I stayed for two nights, and cleaning was done each day, with bottled mineral water replenished as well. All towels were also replaced with new ones. There were no amenities provided (only shampoo and body soap installed in the bathroom). Taipei hotels do not provide amenities, so you either have to bring your own or obtain them locally. There are many restaurants and convenience stores in the vicinity of the hotel, so there's no need to worry. I have traveled to Taipei several times, and this hotel is one I would like to use again next time.

name: We Come Hostel
detail: Very clean, very new, worth more than the price (on weekdays). If I go again, I would stay here again. Quiet and peaceful, with a shrine over 100 years old nearby, not far from the beimen station exit. I highly recommend it.

name: WORK INN TPE
detail: The dormitory and private rooms are smaller compared to other hostels, but they are very clean and the location (next to exit M8) is great for when you arrive at the accommodation and when traveling to other cities or heading to the airport. There are convenience stores nearby and good food options. The male and female accommodations are completely separated by floor, which is very nice. There is also a small but clean common lounge with air conditioning. I stayed for two nights and the receptionist (the one wearing glasses) was very friendly, and I didn't have many inconveniences. Some reviews mention that the bunk beds in the dormitory are small, but I didn't find it uncomfortable for sleeping (I'm 179 cm tall)... However, the room is quite small, so there isn't much space to store large suitcases or big backpacks, but they said they will keep them for you if you talk to the reception... Anyway, for my standards, if I come back to Taipei, I would like to stay at this accommodation again.
area: Taipei Main Station,Taipei - View on map

name: Work Inn 101
detail: I stayed for 6 nights at the end of January. The staff was surprised by the 6-night stay. I was well taken care of for a long time. The language used was Chinese and English instead of Japanese. I'm not good at English, but they guided me slowly, so I was able to understand. There was no cleaning service for the room, but it was actually better as I didn't have to pack my belongings for cleaning every day (I could use it like my own room). The shared shower booth was cold during winter and had some mold, but overall it was cleaned almost every day and was kept clean. You cannot flush toilet paper. It was helpful that there were dryers and hair straighteners available. Meals are eaten in the shared space, which was stylish and pleasant. There was a water dispenser, which was convenient. The washing and drying machines could be used for around 500 yen. If you are not looking for hotel-level cleanliness, this place offered great cost performance. The Ningxia Night Market is also nearby. It's close to 101 at the edge of Taipei. Department stores like Mitsukoshi are also close by. It’s about a 7-minute walk from the station, which was convenient. There’s a bus stop right in front, but I never used it since I didn’t understand the routes. There’s a Mos Burger and a 7-Eleven nearby, which was convenient. I was grateful for this quality around 3000 yen. I recommend it.
